# Isaiah Chapter 37 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 38 verses]*

*Hezekiah prays; Isaiah's oracle; Sennacherib mocked; 185,000 Assyrians struck; Sennacherib killed*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 37 (Hezekiah's Prayer) addresses hezekiah prays; isaiah's oracle; sennacherib mocked; 185,000 assyrians struck; sennacherib killed. The key verse — "I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for the sake of my servant David" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
